design_notes: Bright, modern dashboard aesthetic with white background and indigo/teal gradient accents. Use rounded 12px cards with soft drop shadows. Implement sans-serif typography with bold headers and regular body text. Grid layout optimized for 3 cards per row. Include spike indicators, heatmaps, donut charts, tag/chip lists, bar charts, stacked bars, multi-line charts, and leaderboard tables. Feature a colorful banner strip at top summarizing total volume and top district.
